column1: # ESP32 Partition Table for Encrypted Production Builds (4 MB flash)

column2: no factory app: an OTA upload is written to the slot that is NOT
so a failed or interrupted update always leaves the old firmware bootable.

column1: # Each slot is 0x1C0000 (1.75 MB) for a ~1.1 MB image. Slot offsets are 64 KB aligned.
# otadata MUST stay at 0xe000: PlatformIO writes boot_app0.bin (8 KB) there whatever this table says
# place would overwrite the end of nvs or the start of the next partition on every upload (scripts/make_firmware_bundles.py
# and its test fail the build if this ever drifts). nvs is 20 KB like the development layout.
